description: Where Claude Code compacted the conversation (summarised what came before to free its context window): a quiet centred line between two horizontal rules, saying what it did, with the summary it wrote folded under it.

parts.name: line
parts.shows: Full width, 6px above and below: a rule, the text (small, 0.85em, 60% opacity, centred, wrapping, selectable), a rule. Tooltip over all of it: "Claude Code summarised the conversation so far, to free its context window: the summary stands in for what came before".

parts.name: summary
parts.shows: Under the line, once known: a disclosure "Summary of the earlier conversation" (small, dimmed), folded. Opened, the summary as markdown, 18px in, 6px under it.

states.name: running
states.shows: "Compacting the conversation" followed by working dots (•, ••, ••• cycling); or "Compacting the conversation · <N> characters of summary written".

states.name: done
states.shows: "Conversation compacted automatically" / "Conversation compacted (/compact)" / "Conversation compacted", then " · 167k tokens of context → 18k" (or " · 167k tokens of context" without the after), then " · 41s" (or " · 1m 5s") when it took a second or more.

states.name: failed
states.shows: The text in the error colour at full opacity: "Compaction failed: <error>" or "Compaction failed".

states.name: unfinished
states.shows: Its turn ended first: "Compaction didn't finish" in red.

states.name: nothing to do
states.shows: A compaction that ends without making one (a hook blocked it) removes its mark.

states.name: summary without its mark (history)
states.shows: A summary whose boundary isn't drawn yet shows on its own as a small dimmed "Summary of the earlier conversation" disclosure, and moves under its mark when that is drawn.
